title: Exapunks (2018)
summary: Exapunks is a programming puzzle game developed by Zachtronics where players write code in a fictional assembly-like language called EXA to solve hacking challenges across various levels set in a cyberpunk world.
problem_solved: Teaches programming logic and problem-solving through engaging puzzle gameplay in an immersive cyberpunk narrative.
why_valuable: Makes learning low-level programming concepts accessible and entertaining while encouraging creative solutions to complex problems.
